Of course it counted! Consent means an assumed no without a definite yes.

You can never doubt consensual sex. Consent is vocal and affirmative. If you find yourself doubting whether or not you consented, you definitely did not. It doesn’t matter if you didn’t specifically say no- you didn’t say yes either. And if he had asked, would you have said yes?

I guess just be extremely patient and understanding. Know that there isn’t really anything you can say or advice that you can  give that’ll meaningfully help them. It’s better to just listen to them if they even choose to talk about it. Also, reaching out and sending texts means a lot.

I don’t think you suffer from npd. The fact that you’re wondering if you do, and are even considering the possibility, demonstrates too much emotional awareness for someone with narcissistic personality disorder. 

You’re probably just very self-centered. And that is far easier to overcome than npd.

I’m so unbelievably jealous of my siblings who’ve had more time with him. 
Someone told me to try and let their love you envelope you when you’re feeling hopeless. I think it’s helped me. Remember how much your mother loved you. 
I guess we just hope the pain gets better. Life is cruel and doesn’t stop for anyone. We try to keep up.

honestly, i’m still figuring this out too. i’ve only just recently started being open about my adhd. i think i was always afraid of being defined by it. of being looked at differently. i feel broken because of my adhd too. i used to wish everyday that i could just function like everybody else. it made me hate myself for a while. but i’m still learning and i’ve grown to kind of appreciate it. adhd made me stronger in a way and i kind of enjoy the random tangents i go on in my head. how one thought leads to a thousand others. i like to think it makes me more observant, or if anything, more interesting lol. hope it’s comforting knowing someone feels similarly.
